snippet.title: 3D Baseball (1996) PS1 - Gameplay HD
snippet.description:
3D Baseball is a sports game developed and published by Crystal Dynamics. It was released on October 31, 1996, for the PlayStation version, and on November 30, 1996, for the Sega Saturn version. It features CNN sportscaster Van Earl Wright as the announcer.

Initial release date: October 31, 1996
Mode: Multiplayer video game
Developer: Crystal Dynamics
Platforms: Playstation, Sega Saturn
Genres: Sports Video Game, Simulation Game
Publishers: Crystal Dynamics, Bertelsmann Music Group
